{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2014–15 |team=San Diego Toreros |image=San Diego Toreros logo.svg |image_size=150 |conference=West Coast Conference |division= |short_conf= WCC |APRank= |CoachRank= |record= 15–16 |conf_record= 8–10 |head_coach=[[Bill Grier]] |hc_year = 8th |asst_coach1=Mike Burns |asst_coach2=[[Rodney Tention]] |asst_coach3=Kyle Bankhead |stadium=[[Jenny Craig Pavilion]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2014–15 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2014–15 San Diego Toreros men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of San Diego]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. This was head coach Bill Grier's eighth season at San Diego. The Toreros competed in the [[West Coast Conference]] and played their home games at the [[Jenny Craig Pavilion]]. They finished the season 15–16, 8–10 in WCC play to finish in fifth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2015 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] to Pepperdine. On March 16, head coach Bill Grier was fired.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/12495064/san-diego-toreros-fire-coach-bill-grier|title=San Diego fires coach Grier after eight seasons|date=16 March 2015}} He had an eight-year record of 117–144. ==Previous season== The [[2013–14 San Diego Toreros men's basketball team|Toreros]] finished the season 18–17, 7–11 in WCC play to finish in a tie for sixth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2014 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] to San Francisco. They were invited to the [[2014 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament]] where they defeated Portland State and Sam Houston State to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to fellow WCC member Pacific. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
